evidence.mode: restart after a ready report keeps the Session; an interrupted running report gets a restoration note (four-feature D1/D2)

human_interventions.note: the request and the same-thread change are decisions; no corrective intervention was needed

token_budget.note: the mechanism harness scripts model steps, so token cost is measured from the live session logs instead

readiness_gate.criterion: a person's same-task change on an unlinked channel must attach to the existing ticket
readiness_gate.case: chat A request, chat B change with no explicit reference
readiness_gate.reason: Correlation adds context but never routes; only the originating thread, a ticket PR thread or an explicit pointer attaches. The same-thread form passes (tested above and observed live); the unlinked cross-channel form has no path.

verdict.rule: the composite path may run only when every readiness criterion holds; a failing criterion names the layer.
